verdict.rationale: Make exposes a broad REST API (scenarios via MCP, connections, data stores, webhooks, custom apps, AI agents, analytics, audit logs, OAuth) covering most core account/automation objects, suggesting wide but not confirmed full parity with the UI. There's no explicit statement or independent confirmation that literally every UI action (e.g., visual scenario building, full drag-and-drop module configuration) is API-accessible, and an OpenAPI spec discovery probe failed. missing for 10: explicit full-parity claim/documentation, independent verification that all UI-only features (visual designer, some admin panels) are reachable via API, working OpenAPI/machine-readable spec.
